title: JRE 2306 - Deric Poston
guestBio: Deric Poston is a standup comic and host, along with Ehsan Ahmad, of "The Solid Show." Look for his new Don't Tell Comedy special on YouTube - https://youtu.be/iGW8iZSJxYA?si=XSRAc45AKUJqtZds
tldr: Deric Poston discusses his comedy career and The Solid Show podcast with co-host Ehsan Ahmad
Conversation covers standup comedy, the comedy special format, and performing in different venues
Discussion about the evolution of comedy content and distribution through platforms like YouTube
Poston shares insights about hosting duties and what makes a good comedic interview show
Talk about the comedy industry's transition from traditional media to digital platforms
Mentions of his Don't Tell Comedy special and the process of creating comedy content
recap:
Joe Rogan sits down with standup comic and host Deric Poston to dive into the world of comedy, hosting, and content creation. Poston, who co-hosts The Solid Show alongside Ehsan Ahmad, brings a fresh perspective on the modern comedy landscape and what it takes to make it in the industry today.

The conversation centers around Poston's approach to standup and hosting, exploring how comedians are adapting to new platforms and audiences. They discuss the importance of finding your voice as a performer and the challenges of translating comedy to different mediums. Poston's work on The Solid Show demonstrates how podcasting and streaming have opened new doors for comedians to reach audiences beyond traditional comedy clubs and theaters.

Poston also talks about his Don't Tell Comedy special, which is available on YouTube, and the shifting landscape of comedy specials in the streaming era. The discussion touches on how comedians navigate the pressures of creating content while maintaining authenticity and comedic integrity. Joe and Deric explore what makes certain comedy specials resonate with audiences and how platform choices affect a comedian's reach and career trajectory.

Throughout the episode, there's an emphasis on the grind of comedy, the importance of stage time, and how comedians are building careers in an increasingly digital world. The conversation reflects on how The Solid Show works as a platform for comedians to showcase their talents and personalities beyond just their standup material.
